author: A. Mwangi
note: Three industrial customers in Industrial Area reported voltage sag events during the morning shift. Correlates with the steel plant arc furnace startup around 09:30. Busbar voltage dipped to 0.92 pu for roughly eight seconds.

author: J. Otieno
note: Completed quarterly maintenance on transformer T2 at Nairobi West. Dissolved gas analysis samples taken; results expected from the lab within five working days. Cooling bank B fans cleaned and tested.

author: R. Kiptoo
note: Capacitor bank C1 at Nakuru North tripped on unbalance protection. Fuse on phase B can blown. Replacement fuse scheduled for the afternoon switching window.

author: S. Hassan
note: Planned outage at Mombasa Island feeder F3 next Tuesday 08:00-12:00 for vegetation clearance along the coastal corridor. Affected customers notified through the county office.

author: A. Mwangi
note: Load transfer of two feeders from Industrial Area to Nairobi West completed to relieve the heavily loaded transformer T1. Post-switching load split now within design margins.

author: R. Kiptoo
note: Intermittent SCADA communication loss with Nakuru North RTU. DNP3 polling timeouts observed for six minutes before link recovered. Vendor ticket opened for the radio modem.

author: J. Otieno
note: Residential complaints in the Nairobi West supply area about flickering lights in the evening peak. Initial checks point to a loose tap on the distribution transformer rather than upstream sag.

author: S. Hassan
note: Lightning arrestor on the Mombasa Island incoming bay replaced after the coastal storm. Insulation resistance test passed at 5 GOhm. Recloser counters reset and verified.

author: P. Njoroge
note: Harmonic distortion measured at Industrial Area exceeded the 5 percent THD limit during the factory shift. Traced to a cement plant variable speed drive operating without its harmonic filter.

author: R. Kiptoo
note: Transformer oil level top-up completed at Nakuru North after the routine inspection found a slow gasket seep on the main tank. Gasket replacement booked for the next planned outage.

author: P. Njoroge
note: Distance protection relay at Nairobi West picked up on a transient fault and reclosed successfully. Fault locator placed the event 4.2 km out on the Kikuyu feeder; patrol team dispatched.

author: S. Hassan
note: Emergency load transfer executed at Mombasa Island after the port cold-storage expansion pushed feeder F1 above its emergency rating. Shedd 1.8 MW onto the standby interconnector for two hours.

author: A. Mwangi
note: Voltage regulation study requested for Industrial Area evening shift. LTC tap position data logged for one week starting today to quantify the daily regulation duty on transformer T1.

author: P. Njoroge
note: Station battery bank discharge test at Nakuru North completed. Runtime measured at 7.4 hours against a 6-hour requirement. One cell flagged for monitoring, replacement ordered.
